ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect EC, and BE intersects MN at point F, \\
since rectangle ABCD, E is the midpoint of AD, and AE=1cm, \\
therefore AB=CD, AD=BC=2AE=2cm, ED=1cm, \\
since FC is perpendicular bisector of BE, \\
therefore EC=BC=2cm, $\angle$BFC=$\angle$EFC=$90^\circ$, \\
therefore in Rt$\triangle$EFC, CD= $\sqrt{EF^{2}-ED^{2}}=\sqrt{2^{2}-1^{2}}=\sqrt{3}$, \\
therefore AB=CD= $\boxed{\sqrt{3}}$cm.

Therefore in right triangle $EFC$, $CD=\sqrt{EF^{2}-ED^{2}}=\sqrt{2^{2}-1^{2}}=\sqrt{3}$, therefore $AB=CD=\boxed{\sqrt{3}}\text{ cm}$.
